paragraphs: The X6 M50d was the flagship diesel variant of the second-generation X6, sold from 2014 to 2019. It uses the N57 — BMW’s renowned 3.0-litre inline-six diesel, but in its most powerful tri-turbo configuration. This engine, shared with the X5 M50d of the same era, features three turbochargers in series to deliver impressive performance and torque. The X6 M50d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the X6 M50d uses a complex, high-output version of the N57 engine, exact component matching is critical.
